items.title: Defensive 'masterclass' and elite Rice - how Arsenal ended Anfield torment
items.summary: Not since 2012 - when current boss Mikel Arteta was commanding Arsenal's midfield on the pitch - had the Gunners won on Liverpool’s patch. That curse has finally been broken.

items.title: Rice relishing title race 'anxiety' after win at Liverpool
items.summary: Declan Rice joins BBC Sport's Kelly Cates, Danny Murphy and Micah Richards to analyse how Arsenal earned their first Premier League victory at Liverpool in 14 years.

items.title: ‘I don’t forget’ – Piero Hincapie aims dig at Virgil van Dijk after Arsenal’s win at Liverpool as fans hail ‘petty king’
items.summary: PIERO HINCAPIE appeared to aim a cheeky dig at Virgil van Dijk after Arsenal beat Liverpool 1-0. Kai Havertz's 13th minute strike was enough to earn the Gunners their first win at Anfield since 2014. Hincapie, 24, came on as an 84th minute substitute for Christos Tzolis to help see out the victory.

items.title: ‘Embarrassing’ – Carragher blasts Mac Allister for ‘joke’ falling theatrics vs Arsenal and demands ‘this has to stop’
items.summary: JAMIE CARRAGHER launched a scathing attack on Alexis Mac Allister after trying to get Noni Madueke sent off. items.title: Ravens QB Jackson to undergo surgery in new injury setback
items.summary: Lamar Jackson will undergo surgery on his right thumb and miss at least the next four games on injured reserve, Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter confirmed on Sunday.

items.title: Antonelli crowned world champion as Verstappen wins wild Mexico City GP
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli became the youngest Formula 1 world champion in history as Max Verstappen held off Lewis Hamilton to win a thrilling Mexico City Grand Prix.
